en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus, from Jameel who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Words of the Mighty and Majestic [48:4] He it is Who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the Momineen (plural of Momin).
He (the narrator) said, ‘(What about) [58:22] and He has Supported them with a Spirit from Him.
And about Hisazwj Words [48:26] and Necessitated for them the word of piety.
He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘It is the faith’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa ibn ‘Ubayd from Yunus from Jamil who has said the following:
“Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious,
‘It is He who has sent serenity (al-Sakinah) into the hearts of the believers.’ [48:4]
1 then asked about, ‘ . . . and supported them with a spirit from Him. . . .’ [58:22]
I asked him about the words of Allah, ‘He made them to accompany piousness. . . .’ [48:26]
